data.explanation: This official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) states you drove 21 km/h over the 50 km/h limit in a built-up area and imposes a €143.50 fine (including fee and delivery costs) plus one point on your driving record (Fahreignungsregister). You can decide whether to accept this or file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldbehörde instead — the app shows the deadline for that below. If you don't object by the deadline shown, the notice becomes legally binding and the amount becomes due two weeks later; if you do object, a court will review the case and could also decide against you. If you plan to contest it, consider consulting a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsanwalt).

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: If you dispute the offense or the fine, submit a written objection (Einspruch) to the Landkreis Beispielmünde – Bußgeldbehörde, or have it recorded in person there.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the fine and the point become legally binding (rechtskräftig) and enforceable.
items.quote: Die Frist für den Einspruch beträgt zwei Wochen ab Zustellung; einzulegen ist er schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Beispielmünde – Bußgeldbehörde.

items.title: Pay the fine total (Bußgeld)
items.action: Pay the total amount to the account shown once the notice becomes legally binding, unless you file an objection in time.
items.consequence: Late payment can lead to enforcement measures (Vollstreckung).
